item.title: Heritage Funding Opens New Chapter for Ambitious Canna Regeneration Project
item.description: This project matters because it blends heritage, community ambition and sustainable tourism, offering Canna the chance to grow its economy while protecting the island’s identity and giving residents a warm, modern gathering space at the heart of their shared story.The post Heritage Funding Opens New Chapter for Ambitious Canna Regeneration Project appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Council Welcomes New Flexibility in Plans for Visitor Levy Scheme
item.description: This story matters because new flexibility could allow Highland Council to design a fairer, more workable visitor levy that reflects the region’s unique tourism pressures while supporting the services and infrastructure relied on by millions of visitors each year.The post Highland Council Welcomes New Flexibility in Plans for Visitor Levy Scheme appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Eilidh Munro Calls for Radical Shift to Strengthen Social Care Across The Highlands

item.title: Orkney Islands Council Invites Public To Shape Next Year’s Budget
item.description: This story matters because Orkney residents are being given a direct say in decisions that will shape essential services, and their feedback will influence how the Council responds to rising pressures while protecting support for the community’s most vulnerable people.The post Orkney Islands Council Invites Public To Shape Next Year’s Budget appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Pete Wishart Says House of Lords Needs Scrapped Not Stuffed With More Peers
item.description: This story matters because plans to expand the House of Lords raise questions about political trust, public spending and democratic accountability, and the SNP argues that the only meaningful reform is to abolish the chamber rather than add to its already bloated size.The post Pete Wishart Says House of Lords Needs Scrapped Not Stuffed With More Peers appeared first on The Highland Times.
